description.value: Dolce Amore LoLo is an artisan affogato bar and gelato lounge in North Vancouver's Lower Lonsdale neighbourhood, handcrafting organic gelato from grass-fed milk and cream sourced from certified BC farms. The shop has expanded beyond gelato into breads, cookies, and pastries made with organic whole-grain flours, blending Italian tradition with a deep commitment to local, organic sourcing. Both indoor and outdoor seating are available, making it a comfortable rest stop for cyclists on the North Shore waterfront corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a real, active business at 113 2nd St W, North Vancouver — the LoLo location described as 'The Lounge - AFFOGATO BAR-' with phone (604) 929-1292, matching OSM exactly. The site features an 'Order Now' button and app download for ordering, confirming takeout. OSM tags diet:vegan=yes and indoor/outdoor seating; the website does not contradict vegan options but does not explicitly confirm them either. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or Wi-Fi are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM tag diet:vegan=yes could not be confirmed from website content — the website describes dairy-based gelato (grass-fed milk, organic cream) as the core product without explicitly listing vegan alternatives; left as null pending on-site verification.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active artisan gelato and affogato bar confirmed open via website with matching contact details. A natural stop for cyclists on the Lower Lonsdale waterfront.
enrichment_extras.notes: Dolce Amore operates three locations: LoLo (North Vancouver, this record), Burnaby (6011 Hastings St), and Commercial Drive Vancouver (returning Summer 2026). The LoLo location is branded 'The Lounge — Affogato Bar.'
